question: In the Kirkpatrick model of evaluation, Level 2 (Learning) assesses whether participants actually changed their health behaviour in real-life settings after the programme.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — this is FALSE. Level 2 (Learning) measures knowledge gain or skill demonstration during or immediately after the session. Actual behaviour change in real-life settings is Level 3 (Behaviour), assessed through follow-up observation or self-report.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is FALSE. Level 2 assesses knowledge or skill acquisition measured immediately after training (e.g., a post-test). Behaviour change in real-life settings is Level 3 (Behaviour), which requires follow-up assessment days or weeks later.
